actors.name: Mohanlal
actors.style_description: Effortlessly arrogant, subtly dangerous, and charismatic.
actors.signature_delivery: Tilting the head, a slight smile, speaking softly before delivering a loud punch.
best_for_situations: When you need to assert dominance smoothly

actors.name: Mammootty
actors.style_description: Intense, articulate, often with a powerful booming voice or a very slow, calculated tone.
actors.signature_delivery: Staring directly, delivering long, uninterrupted English-laced dialogues.

actors.name: Suresh Gopi
actors.style_description: Explosive, loud, heavily reliant on English swear words and direct threats.
actors.signature_delivery: Pointing fingers, heavy breathing, shouting suddenly.

actors.name: Fahadh Faasil
actors.signature_delivery: Wide eyes, fake smiles, whispering insults.
best_for_situations: When acting crazy wins the argument

actors.name: Prithviraj
actors.style_description: Stubborn, unyielding, with a hint of educated arrogance.
actors.signature_delivery: Deadpan stare, speaking with extreme conviction.

actors.name: Tovino Thomas
actors.style_description: Modern, grounded, slightly goofy but tough.
actors.signature_delivery: Casual body language, reacting like it's a joke.

actors.name: Dileep
best_for_situations: Making a joke out of a serious threat

actors.name: Jagathy Sreekumar
actors.style_description: Master of timing, bizarre logic, and legendary facial expressions.
actors.signature_delivery: Confusing the opponent with sheer absurdity.
best_for_situations: When you have no logical comeback

actors.name: Sreenivasan
actors.style_description: Satirical, dry humor, overly intellectual but flawed.
actors.signature_delivery: Speaking like a professor about something very stupid.

actors.name: Innocent
actors.style_description: Helpless frustration, unique Thrissur slang, hilarious cowardice.
actors.signature_delivery: Scratching the head, looking up, complaining to God.

actors.name: Salim Kumar
actors.style_description: Dark humor, cynical, brutally honest about his own failures.
actors.signature_delivery: Deadpan delivery of the most depressing or sarcastic lines.
